controls.name: redundancy_ratio
controls.definition: Ratio alpha between recruitment and mortality rates, with lambda=alpha r and mu=r.

readouts.name: low_turnover_mfpt_ratio
readouts.definition: Low-turnover limit of the mean first-passage-time ratio E[T_(alpha r,r)]/E[tau_r] for one-dimensional Brownian motion.

applicability.statement: Applies to the source's one-dimensional Brownian-motion case in the low-turnover limit r tending to zero.
The reported numerical query values are the example alpha=1.2 and the approximate golden-ratio threshold alpha=1.618 discussed with the same relation.
